description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android activity named CartActivity, which manages the shopping cart UI, interactions, and state management in an online shopping platform.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the shopping cart UI, user interactions, and state updates for an online shopping platform.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds state and event handlers.

methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation action.

methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView with adapter, layout, and swipe-to-delete callback.

methods.name: onActivityResult

methods.name: bindState

methods.name: bindCouponUi

methods.description: Handles error events and user identity prompts.

methods.description: Displays a dialog with saved coupons, allowing selection or removal.
